basis.en: Public domain: the artist died in 1677. SMK marks this image as public domain (Public Domain Mark 1.0).
basis.zh: 公有领域：作者卒于 1677 年。丹麦国家美术馆（SMK）将此图像标为公有领域（公有领域标记 1.0）。

alt.en: A Dutch river at night under a sky of heavy clouds lit from behind by the moon. A church tower and a village stand in silhouette on the left bank, a moored boat with tall masts sits by trees on the right, and silver light catches on the water between them.
alt.zh: 夜里的荷兰河景，浓重的云层被月亮从背后照亮。左岸的教堂塔楼和村庄映成剪影，右边树旁停着一条高桅的船，两岸之间的水面闪着银光。

note.en: Aert van der Neer built a whole career on two subjects, moonlit rivers and frozen winters, and painted them with a patience few of his contemporaries shared. The moon itself is hidden; we see it only at the edges of the clouds and on the water. His son Eglon, whose reader hangs nearby, painted rooms instead.
note.zh: 阿尔特·范德内尔一生只画两类题材：月下的河流和冰封的冬天，而且画得极有耐心，同时代人少有能及。月亮本身藏起来了，我们只在云的边缘和水面上看到它。他的儿子埃格隆——那幅读书人就挂在附近——画的却是房间。
